versions.changelog:
Initial release of the File Finder & Sender skill:

- Enables searching for local files or folders by name, file extension, or content.
- Copies selected files to a dedicated “檔案接收櫃” folder on the Desktop for easy user access.
- Supports searching in common directories such as Desktop, Documents, and Downloads.
- Integrates with LINE chat to send files directly via local path recognition.
- Automatically opens the destination folder after files are copied.
